stem.text: A satellite uses two thrusters to adjust its motion in space.

Each thruster exerts a force of $40\,\text{N}$ on the satellite. The line of action of each force is a perpendicular distance of $2.3\,\text{m}$ from the centre of gravity of the satellite. These two parallel forces act in opposite directions.

stem.alt: Diagram of a satellite with two solar panels and two thrusters, labelled satellite and thruster; forces labelled 40 N each; distances labelled 2.3 m each.

stem.text: What are the magnitudes of the torque and the resultant force acting on the satellite due to the two thrust forces?
